title: Harvest Moon
tuning: D A D G B E

alt_voicings.label: Riff up the neck
alt_voicings.note: the guitartabs.cc version of the riff

sections.name: Riff
sections.note: D → D6 → Dmaj7 is an inner line A → B → C♯; rhythm approximate, follow the record.

sections.name: Verse, second half
sections.note: The harmonica solo uses this same pattern.

why: **Drop D with moving inner voices**: the D–D6–Dmaj7 riff is pure voice leading, and a 6/9 colour up the neck.
hard_change: **Going in and out of the riff** at the end of each 4-bar chord.
theory: ii–I–IV–I verse; V7sus4–V7 chorus; the riff is an inner line on the I chord.
steps: Retune to drop D. The riff alone, slowly, then Em ↔ riff.
With the record (outro: riff ×4, ending on D).
tips: One chart lists Em7 and G6 for Em and G — optional colours.
